title: Add a personal named 'strategy' tag to positions and closed trades
description: Elder ch. 55/56/58/59 all lean on the trader tagging every trade with a personal, named strategy/setup type (his own examples: 'false breakout with a divergence,' 'pullback to value') to later see which of their own setups perform best. Nothing in this app's schema captures this today. This is foundational: backend-trade-apgar depends on it, and the ch.59 idea's 'equity curves segmented by strategy' needs it too. Scope here is just the field and its plumbing, not the Apgar or equity-curve features themselves.

checklist.step: Add a nullable `strategy` string field to PositionIn/PositionOut/PositionORM.
Carry `strategy` through to ClosedTradeORM/ClosedTradeOut when a position is closed (DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id}).

Decide free-text vs. a user-managed fixed list of strategies, and record the rationale (Elder's own framing is that strategies are personal and evolve over time -- 'you may develop new strategies and drop others').
Unit/integration tests covering a position created with and without a strategy tag, and that it carries through correctly to the closed-trade row on close.
